purpose_note: Create a forecast curve for the day. Refine uses the same kitchen sink as blind plus realized price/curve as causal evidence; blind stays immutable.
posterior_rule: R6 carry-forward from 20260727: buy-flow sign has no bullish authority without price delivery. Positive flow into a large falling-price phase is failed buying/absorption pressure; only a later rising-price phase can begin repairing that state, and a small repair does not erase the delivered trend.
lesson: The blind made the exact mistake July 27 just taught us not to make: it treated prior +3052 buy flow as continuation. Tuesday's own middle phase had positive flow (+196) while price collapsed -$700. The live causal state says sellers still owned price despite apparent buying; the +$110 final phase is only a late repair.
carry_forward: Once positive-flow/falling-price absorption is established, do not recycle aggregate buy flow as next-day bullish evidence. Require a full causal phase of rising price with aligned flow before chain direction can flip back up.
anti_overfit_note: Endpoint is gap + sum of causal phase price changes (0-210-700+110=-800), using the same reconstruction rule as every g24 day.
